verdict.rationale: Render's own site says it serves static assets faster with caching powered by its global CDN, which matches the story almost word for word. Community comments praising Render's free static sites lend some indirect support to static asset hosting. However, the evidence is only a one-line marketing claim. missing for 10: in-depth docs on edge caching behavior (cache headers, invalidation/purge, edge locations), any performance data, and independent or hands-on confirmation of CDN edge caching.
